After attacking, gains [[Health Regen]] for 6 seconds. |ability1_cooldown = 12 }} ==Description== The '''Void Knight''' is a tanky enemy that appears in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] and [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] modes. It has high health and below average speed, alongside multiple immunities to many forms of stalling. It has one ability where it will swing its sword up to two times at a tower or unit, creating a slash with a radius of 8 and an angle of 20. This will stun towers for 5 seconds and deal 132 damage to units. Using this ability will also give it [[Health Regen]] for 6 seconds. ==Logbook Description== "''Void Knights are the trusted warriors of Void Caster. They follow her everywhere and were the first to be woken from their slumber when the time came to march again. These Knights serve the Void Caster’s will absolutely, commanded by the Void Sword Master, her lead knight and the only one permitted to give them orders in her absence. They train without rest, sparring against one another and whatever unfortunate creatures stumble too close in the Void. They are known hunters, relentless in pursuit, and will chase a target across the nothing for as long as it takes. They do not stop. They do not tire. And they have never once failed to complete a mission, which is something the Void Sword Master makes sure everyone in the army is aware of.''" ==Appearance== The '''Void Knight''' has a black body. It wears purple and gold body armor consisting of a chestplate, leggings, shoulder pads, armbands, shoes and helmet. It wears a brown cape. Various purple spikes come out of its armor and on many spots of it there are purple gems. On the top of its helmet, it has a purple plume. Purple aura comes out of right eye. It wields a purple sword which it attacks towers and units with. ==Strategy== *The '''Void Knight''' has high health, meaning units with high DPS such as the [[Juggernaut]], [[Accelerator]] and [[Pursuit]] are recommended against it. **Support towers like the [[Commander]], [[DJ Booth]] or [[Medic]] can be used to boost the DPS of your towers. *The '''Void Knight''' stuns towers, making stun immune towers useful here. **The [[Medic]] can be used to protect towers by either giving them [[Stun Immunity]] or giving them a shield which will need to recharge when broken. **Top path [[Juggernaut]] can also be used to reduce the stun duration on towers in its secondary range. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Hardcore Rework Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Void Knight''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Cutscenes}} Hardcore Cutscene 1 Tower Defense Simulator|'''Void Knight''' in the [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] mode cutscene. {{GalleryHeader|Concept Art}} VoidKnightCA.png|'''Void Knight''' on its concept art. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} VoidKnightIconIG.png|'''Void Knight''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Void Knight''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **'''Void Knight''' added. *'''17 July 2026''' - [[v2.3.0]] **Cash given on death decreased from {{Money|42,000}} to {{Money|35,000}}. {{Hardcore|[[Elite Soul]], [[Unknown Boss]] & [[Heavy Voidling]]|Wave 41|Void Knight & [[Void Trickster]]|Wave 42|[[Void Swordmaster]]|Wave 43}} {{Voidcore|[[Heavy Voidling]]|Wave 46|Void Knight|Wave 47|[[Void Swordmaster]]|Wave 48}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
